PSALM CXXIX. 
 
  The people of God commemorate their deliverance out of sore   afflictions, ver. 1-4.   The destruction of their enemies, ver. 5-8.   A song of degrees. 
 
  V. 1. From my youth-From the time that I was a people.
V. 4. Righteous-Faithful or merciful.  The cords-Wherewith the plow was drawn.  By these cords he understands all their plots and endeavours.
V. 6. House-tops-Which there were flat.  Which-Having no deep root, never comes to maturity.  And so all their designs shall be abortive.
V. 8. The blessing-Which was an usual salutation given by passengers to reapers: so the meaning is, it never continues 'till the harvest comes.
